spec.status: pilot candidate, not a validated data domain
spec.strain_convention: e = [E11, E22, 2 E12]; straight rays e(t) = t endpoint; axial strain, not uniaxial stress
spec.numerical_revision: Original 200/400 density specification is frozen in pilot_v1/spec.json. Coarse-mesh x compression failed at -0.01 with density 200; diagnostic runs at 400 and 800 reached -0.04. Geometry, target strains and screening tolerances remain unchanged.

geometry.rationale: Disjoint enclosed ellipses leave a connected solid. Nearest periodic images suffice; farther translations increase at least one coordinate separation. Circle gaps are lower bounds, not exact ligaments.

scope: Numerical screening at specified states, not proof of stability, uniqueness, contact absence, or accuracy throughout a strain box. Two meshes show sensitivity, not asymptotic convergence. Tangent symmetry is checked using unsymmetrized stress finite differences; the consistent solver tangent is symmetrized internally.
